newsitem.title: USA: TCW Group closes $1.05 bln leveraged income trust.
newsitem.headline: TCW Group closes $1.05 bln leveraged income trust.

text.p: TCW Group Inc, the parent of Trust Co of the West, said Wednesday it closed the $1.05 billion TCW Leveraged Income Trust LP.
The collateralized loan and securities fund will focus on a range of high yield asset classes, including public and private high yield investments, special situations and bank loans.

The company said the fund's goal is to generate 20 percent average annualized returns to the limited partners from a targeted 12.5 percent return on assets, while providing a current return based on the adjusted net income of the fund.
The fund, to be managed by Mark Attanasio and Robert Beyer, has a $535 million senior secured revolving credit facility.

In addition, the fund's capital structure includes $50 million of senior secured floating rate notes, $150 million of senior secured fixed rate notes, $105 million of subordinated secured notes and $210 million of equity partnership interests, the company said.
The TCW Group of companies, headquartered in San Francisco, said has over $50 billion in assets under management.
